verdicts.title: From Small Space to Small Width in Resolution
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In 2003, Atserias and Dalmau resolved a major open question about the resolution proof system by establishing that the space complexity of CNF formulas is always an upper bound on the width needed to refute them.
